critical_code_review_comments: GOOD: All 8 pages use consistent Luminous Precision theme with cyan (#22D3EE) as primary accent
GOOD: Background color #050508 (deep black) applied via bg-[#050508] class
GOOD: Glassmorphism consistently applied via backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08]
GOOD: All pages have proper data-testid attributes for testing
GOOD: FadeInSection component with framer-motion provides scroll-triggered animations
GOOD: GlassCard component used consistently across all pages for card styling
GOOD: API integration working correctly for Blog, Case Studies, and Inspirations pages
GOOD: Cyan gradient text applied via text-transparent bg-clip-text bg-gradient-to-r from-cyan-400 to-cyan-200
GOOD: Responsive design with proper spacing and typography
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 8 pages (About, Contact, FAQ, Blog, BlogPost, CaseStudiesIndex, CaseStudyDetail, Inspirations) have been redesigned with Luminous Precision theme. Theme uses cyan (#22D3EE) as primary accent, deep black (#050508) as background, and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/[0.03] border border-white/[0.08]) for cards. FadeInSection and GlassCard components are shared across pages. API endpoints /api/blogs, /api/case-studies, /api/inspirations provide data. All pages are fully functional with proper filters, forms, navigation, and interactive elements.
